title: Baseline Audit Report
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact. Output of baseline-comparison-auditor. Compares data/budget/metric/postprocess conditions between baseline and method conditions. Asymmetry flags are derived mechanically by baseline_audit.py; never hand-set.

conditions_compared.description: List of condition_ids compared (must include at least one baseline and one method)

dimension.description: Which comparison dimension has an asymmetry

baseline_value.description: Declared value for the baseline condition on this dimension

method_value.description: Declared value for the method condition on this dimension

asymmetry_flags.description: Each entry is an asymmetry found between a baseline and method condition

clean.description: True iff asymmetry_flags is empty — derived from the flags, not set by hand

notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the auditor
